newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sets specials at 3.5 percent.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sets specials at 3.5 percent.

text.p: The Bank of Canada set special purchase and resale agreements at 3.50 percent in the Canadian money market to re-establish the ceiling for its 50 basis point target range of the overnight financing rate.
Dealers said Canada's central bank intervened to hold the rate steady after the overnight rate began to edge up past the ceiling of the bank's target range.
"It was getting a little tight so they just did a little fine tuning," the dealer said.
After the intervention Canada's call loan rate was trading around 3.50 percent.
